comparison.objective: Separate bulk media from washers vs transfer four sealed cups of unknown weight without crushing or dropping them.
comparison.physical_skill: Control tool pose to pass elongated particles through apertures vs adapt side-wall grip force to hidden loads while transporting fragile containers.
comparison.success_condition: ≥98% media recovery and all washers retained vs every cup side-gripped, lifted, delivered upright, unbuckled, undropped, and released on the tray.
comparison.reason: Both penalize loss, but adaptive fragile-object gripping is not screen-mediated separation.
